name: Multi-Init t-SNE + Multi-Scale NRA
tagline: Runs t-SNE from PCA and Spectral inits, picks the higher-overlap embedding, then refines it with a multi-scale neighborhood-rank-alignment gradient using k=7 and k=15 forces.
diff_from_baseline: Beyond the t-SNE baseline, runs a Spectral-initialized t-SNE in parallel, selects by 7-NN overlap with the high-D space, then performs gradient-based neighborhood-rank refinement with combined k=7 attract/repel and k=15 attract forces.

name: Multi-Scale Spectral + Force Refinement
tagline: Sums symmetric-normalized affinities at four bandwidth scales, takes Laplacian eigenvectors as init, then runs an attractive-affinity / repulsive-kNN gradient with Adam.

key_hyperparams.name: knn_affinity
key_hyperparams.role: rows kept in W per scale

diff_from_baseline: Distinct from all baselines: a multi-scale spectral embedding (Laplacian eigenvectors of summed RBF affinities at four bandwidths) followed by t-SNE-style attractive/repulsive gradient refinement; not based on UMAP/TriMap/PaCMAP libraries.

name: PaCMAP-Style Triplet Forces (Custom)
tagline: From-scratch PaCMAP: continuous local NN affinity, sampled mid-near and far-pair sets, Cauchy/(1+D^2) attraction/repulsion with a 3-phase mid-near schedule, Adam over 500 epochs.
init_recovers: Approximately PaCMAP without the PaCMAP library
diff_from_baseline: Re-implements a PaCMAP-style triplet objective in pure NumPy with custom NN/MN/FP kernels and a three-phase attraction schedule; conceptually close to the pacmap baseline but with hand-tuned weights, kernel scales, and Adam optimization.

name: Spectral + Anchor-MDS Geodesic Fuse
tagline: Mutual-kNN graph -> normalized Laplacian eigenvectors -> anchor-MDS on graph geodesics, fused with the spectral embedding by a confidence-weighted alpha.
diff_from_baseline: Custom hybrid not present in baselines: spectral embedding of a mutual-kNN graph plus a landmark/anchor MDS computed from kNN-graph geodesics, then linearly blended.

name: Multi-Scale Affinity Embedding
tagline: Sums symmetric Gaussian-kNN affinities at k=10/30/100, optimizes a t-SNE-like KL between W and Cauchy Q via Adam from a PCA init for 300 iters.

key_hyperparams.name: lr schedule
key_hyperparams.value: linear ramp first 30 iters, linear decay after

init_recovers: Approximately t-SNE/SNE for a single bandwidth (k_list of length 1)
diff_from_baseline: From-scratch t-SNE-style optimization with a multi-bandwidth Gaussian-kNN affinity (sum over k=10,30,100), Cauchy low-D kernel, PCA init, and Adam; not the sklearn TSNE baseline and not UMAP/TriMap/PaCMAP.
